en.headline: Castle Peak Power cleared to trial hydrogen blend at Lung Kwu Tan plant
en.dek: The government’s hydrogen working group has in principle approved a project to mix up to 5 per cent hydrogen with natural gas in an existing combined-cycle unit.
body: The Environment and Ecology Bureau said on Thursday that the Inter-departmental Working Group on Using Hydrogen as Fuel had in principle agreed another hydrogen trial application, submitted by Castle Peak Power Company Limited.

The company plans to add hydrogen-related facilities at the Lung Kwu Tan Power Station and adjust an existing combined-cycle gas turbine so it can generate electricity by blending hydrogen with natural gas. The target blend ratio is up to 5 per cent.

The working group has now given in-principle approval to 42 hydrogen trial projects. The bureau said the group would continue to review operating data from the trials to refine local safety and technical guidance on hydrogen use. The group includes the Environment and Ecology Bureau, the Transport and Logistics Bureau, the Development Bureau, the Security Bureau and a range of departments covering fire, electrical and mechanical services, planning and labour.

zh.headline: 龍鼓灑發電廠獲准試驗氫氣混燃 目標摻氫最高5%
zh.dek: 環境及生態局表示，氫能源跨部門工作小組原則上同意青山發電有限公司在現有聯合循環機組混燒氫氣與天然氣。
body: 環境及生態局今日表示，氫能源跨部門工作小組原則上同意多一項氫燃料試驗申請，項目由青山發電有限公司提交。
該公司擬在龍鼓灑發電廠增設氫氣相關設施，並調校現有一台聯合循環燃氣渡輪發電機組，在廠內進行氫氣與天然氣混合發電，目標摻氫比例最高為5%。
工作小組至今已原則上同意42個氫能源試驗項目。當局表示會繼續參考試驗所得運作數據及經驗，優化本地氫能應用的安全及技術指引。工作小組由環境及生態局、運輸及物流局、發展局、保安局，以及消防、機電、規劃及勞工等多個部門組成。
